warnings: Uses approximate pivot wavelengths, not filter-throughput integration.
No extinction, redshift, line blanketing, distance, or covariance treatment is applied.
The shared-shape Bazin model is empirical and does not identify an explosion model.
AB zeropoints, Galactic/host extinction, K-corrections, and filter transmission curves are not fitted.

Reported parameter uncertainties are local covariance estimates conditional on the empirical model and supplied independent Gaussian flux errors; they exclude model, calibration, extinction, redshift, and passband systematics.
Peak magnitudes, peak colors, and model peak time are point estimates; propagated uncertainties for those derived quantities are withheld.

persistedQueryReceipts.scope: Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

Rubin alert packets are world-public with no proprietary period, and Fink documents its LSST Science Portal and REST API as real-time, public services requiring no login. Coordinate and first-detection proximity are not proof of source identity.

ZTF alert difference-image PSF photometry; non-detections are retained as upper limits, not forced photometry. Coordinate association does not assert identity. Public ZTF alert photometry served by the ALeRCE broker. Cite Förster et al. (2021), AJ 161, 242, and acknowledge ALeRCE and the Zwicky Transient Facility according to current provider guidance.

rules.missed: a host not in the retained catalogues counts as one candidate at f = missedFractionalOffset
rules.offset: f = separation / directional light radius (SIMBAD shape), else separation x kpc/arcsec(z) / physical scale, else separation / angular scale; term exp(-f); f > maxFractionalOffset gives 0
rules.probable: the top candidate is 'probable' when its posterior >= probablePosterior and >= probableRatio x the next hypothesis
rules.redshift: only when the transient and the candidate both have a redshift: exp(-0.5 (dz / sigma)^2), sigma^2 = sum of the stated errors^2 + floor^2

runs.claimBoundary: Galactic foreground extinction and a star-like Gaia source at the position; context for reading the photometry, not a classification.

rules.point-source: a Gaia DR3 source within pointSourceRadiusArcsec with star probability >= starProbability, or a significant parallax or proper motion

warnings: Pan-STARRS point-source classifications are not retained by CTAS; the point-source flag uses Gaia DR3 only
